headline: 《绿灯军团》双榜领跑，影视热度齐燃
headlineEn: Green Lantern Corps tops both movie and TV charts
summary: 今日影视热搜由《绿灯军团》领跑，电影《怒之杀》与剧集《末日地堡》紧随其后；本周新片仅4部，备受期待的《最后的日出》即将上映。
summaryEn: Green Lantern Corps leads today's buzz, followed by film Rage Kill and series Silo; only 4 new movies this week, with highly anticipated The Last Sunrise coming soon.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》同时登顶电影与剧集热榜。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps tops both movie and TV trending charts.

industryHighlights.text: 今日零新片上映，本周新片仅4部。
industryHighlights.en: Zero movies released today; only 4 new movies this week.
The Last Sunrise is announced as upcoming.

industryHighlights.text: 《玩具总动员5》《奥德赛》进入本周电影热榜。
industryHighlights.en: Toy Story 5 and The Odyssey enter this week's movie charts.
